text: みんな　おまえの　ファンに　なっちまい　やがって！

structure.jp: おまえの　ファンに
なっちまい　やがって！
structure.en: has gone and become, damn it!

patterns.name: 〜やがる
patterns.span: なっちまい　やがって
patterns.explanation: やがる added to a verb shows the speaker is annoyed at whoever did it; ending on やがって leaves the grumble hanging. なっちまい　やがって = 'they had the nerve to go and become...!'

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまう is a rough male short form of てしまう, which says something ended up happening, to your regret. なっちまい = 'ending up becoming'

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: ファンに　なっちまい
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what someone turns into. ファンに　なっちまい = 'ending up becoming a fan'
